summary.en: A first-person WebGL maze crawler where claustrophobic lighting does the heavy lifting for atmosphere.
summary.zh: 第一人称 WebGL 迷宫，光线幽闭、氛围感极强。

description.en: Grope your way through a pitch-dark maze guided by a faint light, find the portal and drop into the next, progressively harder floor.
description.zh: 在黑暗迷宫中摸索出口，靠微弱光源辨路，找到传送门进入下一层，层数递增。

howto.en: WASD to move, mouse to look around.

tip.en: An atmosphere piece — retention runs on pure curiosity. The Three.js plus Box2D stack takes some graphics know-how to overhaul, but swapping textures or maze-generation parameters yields a new variant quickly.
tip.zh: 氛围类游戏，留存靠好奇心。Three.js + Box2D 组合，需要一点图形学基础才能大改，但换贴图/迷宫生成参数就能出新品。
